name: Dreamscape Doctor
source:
In a fictional interpretation of Victorian England lives a man known as The Doctor. He regents a special psychoanalysis clinic that combines spirituality with science where those who’ve been afflicted by past terrors come to seek solace. Nonetheless, the more he continues to explore his clients’ psyche, the more he is made to realise the flaws on his own, culminating in the need to take a look at himself, and coming face to face with the hardest choice he’s ever had.
